atoms.text: The Great Mosque of Mecca is a place of worship in present-day Saudi Arabia. Every day, people who are Muslim pray in the direction of Mecca and the Ka'bah. Mecca is a holy city and many people go on a pilgrimage to visit this holy place.

Every year thousands of people go on a pilgrimage to Mecca during the last month of the Islamic calendar. Many people believe that every able Muslim adult should complete the pilgrimage once in their lifetime.
The Great Mosque has many worshippers and visitors every year and can hold up to 820,000 people.

In the middle of the mosque there is a holy shrine called the Ka'bah, which is usually covered with a black cloth. Mecca has been a holy place for a long time. Parts of the Great Mosque are around 500 years old; the oldest parts were built around 1571. The Great Mosque is an impressive place and is very important to many people.

hint.text: A shrine is a building that holds important religious objects.
